source.title: Monthly Retail Trade Survey: Estimates of Monthly Retail and Food Services Sales by Kind of Business
source.table: https://www.census.gov/retail/mrts/www/mrtssales92-present.xlsx, sheets 2024 to 2026, NOT ADJUSTED block, rows 722 and 722513-722515; the latest 24 months

rows.officialClass: NAICS 722: Food services and drinking places
rows.measure: sales in the month, not adjusted for season, holidays, trading days or prices, 2024-09
rows.note: The publisher prints money, not an index: the month's sales in USD million is the series. National only: no state is published monthly. The subsector holds full-service restaurants with limited-service places, caterers and drinking places; full-service restaurants (722511) are not published monthly.
